text:
noah: quick note from QA: samplekit JS in json_mode is flaking when auth refresh triggers a mid-stream retry. final assembled payload fails schema validation.

tala: can you paste a minimal repro?

noah: steps: 1) start samplekit /generate with `json_mode:true` and a streaming tool that emits array items 2) expire token mid-stream 3) SDK refreshes & retries tail -> stitcher concatenates replayed fragments and we get `][` which breaks JSON.parse.

ben: log snippet:
```
INFO chunk: "\n]"
WARN auth: token expired, refreshing
INFO retrying stream request
INFO chunk (replay): "[\n{\"id\":42}\n"
ERROR schema-validator: Unexpected token ']' at position 1
```

tala: looks like stitcher does `buffer += chunk` and never resets on retry. two fixes: short-term tolerant parse (trim stray separators in json_mode) and long-term: stream session ids or length-prefixed framing so replays are detectable and safe.

ben: agree. short-term patch: the structured-output helper should drop isolated `[`/`]` fragments before parsing when json_mode=true. long-term: add `x-stream-session-id` + `x-chunk-index` headers so client can skip or reset on replays. framing is preferable for robustness.

noah: i'll add a unit test in sdk-js that simulates a replayed prefix and asserts final assembled array equals the concatenation of items, not two separate arrays.

ben: also flagging parity: audit sdk-py and sdk-ts for the same naive stitcher.

sdk-ci-bot: created issue #4981: "sdk-js: streaming json_mode - auth-refresh retry causes invalid fragment concat" (assignees: ben, tala)

tala: i'll draft the stitcher guard and test. thanks all.
